title: Does Thinking More Always Help? Mirage of Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning Models
authors_zh: Soumya Suvra Ghosal、Souradip Chakraborty、Avinash Reddy、Yifu Li、Mengdi Wang、Dinesh Manocha、Furong Huang、Mohammad Ghavamzadeh、Amrit Singh Bedi（机构：马里兰大学、普林斯顿大学、Capital One、Amazon AGI、中央佛罗里达大学）
paper_type_zh: 测试时计算扩展分析与预算分配研究（NeurIPS 2025）
best_for_zh: 需要在长链推理与多路径推理之间设计推理预算的读者。
one_line: The paper diagnoses overthinking under sequential test-time scaling and compares it with parallel allocation of the same reasoning-token budget.
该论文揭示单轨迹延长思考的过度思考拐点，并以并行推理比较同一 token 预算的更稳健分配。
why: It turns the vague instruction to think longer into an explicit, measurable budget-allocation decision with a documented failure regime.
inclusion_reason: It directly measures when additional inference thinking helps or hurts, then compares an alternative allocation of the same test-time token budget.

title: Problem
问题
html:
It is tempting to spend every additional inference token by forcing one reasoning trace to continue with prompts such as “Wait” or “Think more.” That rule treats test-time computation as a monotone quantity: if a little extra thinking raises accuracy, much more should raise it further. It leaves no principled way to identify when a trace has become unproductive or to decide whether the same budget should instead produce independent attempts.

This paper asks whether sequentially extending a reasoning trace really improves reasoning, and how a fixed thinking-token budget should be used when it does not. The relevant object is a budgeted record containing a prompt, one or more reasoning traces, their token cost, final answers, and a selection rule. The paper tests the boundary between useful deliberation and overthinking, then compares allocating tokens to one long path with distributing them across several independent paths.

人们很容易把每一个额外推理 token 都用于强迫同一条推理轨迹继续，例如追加“稍等”或“再多想想”之类的提示。这一规则把测试时计算当作单调增加的量：既然少量额外思考能提高准确率，更多思考理应带来更多提升。它却没有原则性办法判断何时轨迹已不再有效，也无法决定相同预算是否应该用来产生独立尝试。

本文研究顺序延长推理轨迹是否真的改善推理，以及当它不能改善时应如何使用固定的思考 token 预算。相关对象是一条受预算约束的记录，其中包含提示、一个或多个推理轨迹、它们的 token 成本、最终答案与选择规则。论文检验有益审慎思考和过度思考之间的边界，再比较把 token 分配给一条长路径与分配给多条独立路径的效果。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central claim is that longer sequential thinking is not a reliable proxy for better reasoning. Extending a trace can initially increase accuracy, but it also increases the uncertainty and variance of the output distribution. After a task- and model-dependent point, that dispersion outweighs the initial coverage benefit, so the same mechanism that looked helpful at a modest budget produces worse final answers at a larger one.

The proposed alternative is parallel thinking. Rather than place an entire budget in a single continuously extended chain, the method samples several independent reasoning paths whose total token length stays within that budget and returns the answer chosen by majority vote. This changes the allocation decision from “how long should one trace continue?” to “how many independent paths should share the budget, and how should their final answers be aggregated?”

核心主张是：更长的顺序思考并不是更好推理的可靠代理。延长一条轨迹起初可以提升准确率，但也会提高输出分布的不确定性和方差；在一个依赖任务和模型的临界点之后，这种分散带来的损失超过最初的覆盖收益。因此，原本在中等预算下看似有帮助的机制，在更大预算下反而会产生更差的最终答案。

论文提出的替代方案是并行思考。方法不再把全部预算压在一条不断延长的思维链上，而是在该预算内采样多条相互独立的推理路径，并通过多数投票返回被最多路径支持的答案。这将分配问题从“单条轨迹应继续多长”改为“预算应由多少独立路径共享，以及应如何聚合它们的最终答案”。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors define test-time budget control by varying the number of thinking tokens before an answer is allowed to terminate. They study sequential controls that suppress the end-of-thinking marker and append prompts such as “Wait” or “Think more,” then measure accuracy against average thinking-token use. To interpret the observed curve, they use a simple probabilistic model in which increasing policy variance can initially improve overlap with a reward region but later dilute probability mass and lower expected reward; they also measure response-distribution entropy empirically.

For the alternative allocation, a total budget B is divided among N independently generated reasoning traces rather than assigned to one trace. The final answer is selected by majority vote. Experiments compare these procedures on GSM8K, MATH-500, and AIME 2024 using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B. The recorded decision surface is explicit: method, token budget, trace count, trace outputs, aggregation rule, accuracy, and average tokens.

作者通过改变在允许回答结束前可生成的思考 token 数来定义测试时预算控制。他们研究顺序控制：抑制思考结束标记，并追加“稍等”或“再多想想”等提示，再把准确率与平均思考 token 用量对应起来。为解释得到的曲线，论文使用一个简单概率模型：策略方差增大起初会增加与奖励区域的重叠，之后却会稀释概率质量并降低期望奖励；作者还实证测量了回答分布的熵。

在替代分配中，总预算 B 被划分给 N 条独立生成的推理轨迹，而非全部交给一条轨迹，最终答案由多数投票选择。实验在 GSM8K、MATH-500 与 AIME 2024 上比较这些流程，所用模型为 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 与 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B。其记录的决策表面很明确：方法、token 预算、轨迹数量、轨迹输出、聚合规则、准确率和平均 token 数。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across the three reported mathematical benchmarks and three distilled reasoning models, the sequential policy displays a non-monotonic curve: initial extra thinking improves performance and sufficiently long continuation degrades it. One reported GSM8K example raises accuracy from 82.2% to 87.3% as average thinking length grows from 385 to 1,100 tokens, then lowers it to 70.3% at 15,980 tokens. The same analysis reports that extending one model from 385 to 6,136 thinking tokens increases measured output entropy from 0.23 to 2.79.

The parallel comparison tests the same total token budget rather than granting its method unlimited extra computation. The paper reports that at a 16K-token budget, parallel thinking attains up to 22% higher accuracy than sequential extension, and that it maintains or improves accuracy as the budget grows across its plotted settings. This supports the narrower claim that sequential continuation can be an inefficient allocation policy; it does not establish majority vote as an optimal selector for arbitrary tasks, model families, or cost metrics.

在论文报告的三个数学基准和三种蒸馏推理模型上，顺序策略呈现非单调曲线：开始增加思考会提高性能，而继续得足够长又会使性能下降。GSM8K 的一个报告实例显示，平均思考长度从 385 个 token 增至 1,100 个时，准确率由 82.2% 升至 87.3%，但达到 15,980 个 token 时又降至 70.3%。同一分析还报告，将一个模型的思考从 385 个 token 延长到 6,136 个时，测得的输出熵从 0.23 增至 2.79。

并行比较使用相同的总 token 预算，而不是让其方法获得无限增加的额外计算。论文报告，在 16K token 预算下，并行思考相较顺序延长最高可获得 22% 的准确率提升，并且在图示设置中会随预算增加而保持或提高准确率。这支持了更窄的结论：顺序续写可能是低效的分配策略；它并未证明多数投票对任意任务、模型家族或成本指标都是最优选择器。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier discussions often report a favorable point on a longer-thinking curve and implicitly treat further length as more compute applied to the same reasoning skill. This paper changes the evaluation object from a single endpoint to the entire budget-performance curve. It names the failure region, overthinking, and connects it to a measurable change in output uncertainty rather than merely noting that a long prompt sometimes fails.

Its practical novelty is the matched-budget comparison between sequential continuation and parallel independent traces with a fixed aggregation rule. The paper does not introduce a new reward model or claim that majority voting verifies a solution. Instead, it makes token allocation, trace diversity, and answer aggregation explicit variables, so a reader can audit whether a reported gain comes from extra computation, a different distribution of that computation, or a selection effect.

以往讨论常在更长思考曲线上报告一个有利点，并隐含地把继续加长视为对同一推理能力施加更多计算。本文把评估对象从单一终点改为完整的预算—性能曲线，明确命名了失败区域“过度思考”，并将它关联到可测量的输出不确定性变化，而不是只指出长提示有时会失败。

其实际新意是：在匹配预算下，比较顺序续写和带固定聚合规则的并行独立轨迹。论文没有提出新的奖励模型，也没有宣称多数投票能验证解答；相反，它把 token 分配、轨迹多样性和答案聚合明确为变量，使读者可以审计某项收益究竟来自更多计算、计算的不同分布，还是选择效应。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The proposed variance account is deliberately simplified and the entropy observations are evidence of association, not a causal identification of every source of overthinking. Experiments focus on three distilled open reasoning models and mathematical tasks, while the practical value of majority vote depends on path diversity, answer format, and whether several independent paths fit the latency budget. Before deployment, evaluate matched wall-clock cost, correlation among paths, and whether the task admits a reliable answer-level aggregation rule.
论文提出的方差解释有意保持简化，熵的观测也是关联证据，并非对所有过度思考来源的因果识别。实验聚焦三种蒸馏开放推理模型和数学任务，而多数投票的实际价值取决于路径多样性、答案格式，以及延迟预算是否容得下多条独立路径。部署前应评估匹配的实际运行时间、路径之间的相关性，并确认任务是否允许可靠的答案级聚合规则。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when building a test-time controller that must decide between longer deliberation and broader sampling. A useful experiment log should preserve the prompt, budget-control policy, per-trace token count, continuation prompts, all final answers, aggregation outcome, correctness, latency, and cost. Plotting accuracy and diversity against the same total budget is more informative than reporting only the best accuracy obtained at one chosen length, because it exposes the overthinking region and makes alternative allocation policies comparable.
当测试时控制器必须在更长的审慎思考和更广的采样之间做决定时，这篇论文尤其有用。实验日志应保留提示、预算控制策略、每条轨迹的 token 数、续写提示、全部最终答案、聚合结果、正确性、延迟和成本。在相同总预算下绘制准确率与多样性，比只报告某个选定长度上的最佳准确率更有信息量，因为它能暴露过度思考区域，并使不同分配策略可以公平比较。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper in two passes. First follow the budget-control definition and inspect whether sequential and parallel settings really use comparable total tokens; the point is a resource-allocation comparison, not merely a new prompt trick. Then separate the descriptive evidence from the explanatory model: the plotted non-monotonic curves and entropy measurements establish the observed behavior, whereas the variance argument offers an interpretation. Finally, test the paper's recommendation with a task-specific selector if majority voting is unsuitable for the target answer format.
可分两遍阅读。第一遍跟随预算控制定义，检查顺序与并行设置是否确实使用了可比较的总 token；重点是资源分配比较，而不只是新的提示技巧。第二遍区分描述性证据与解释模型：图中的非单调曲线和熵测量建立了观察到的行为，方差论证则给出一种解释。最后，如果多数投票不适合目标答案格式，应使用任务特定的选择器检验论文建议。
